map.均方误差 RMSE 使用指南: Root Mean Squared Error RMSE User Guide
map.回归误差计算器，输入预测值与真实值求 MSE、RMSE、MAE 与 R²，全面评: Regression Error Calculator: enter the predicted and actual values to get MSE, RMSE, MAE and R², giving a full assessment of the regression model's fit accuracy.
map.MSE = (Σyᵢ² − 2Σyᵢŷᵢ + Σŷᵢ²)/n；RMSE = √M: MSE = (Σyᵢ² − 2Σyᵢŷᵢ + Σŷᵢ²)/n; RMSE = √MSE; MAE = |Σyᵢ − Σŷᵢ|/n; R² = 1 − SSres/SStot
map.平方和展开式可在只有汇总量时算 MSE，避免逐样本遍历。RMSE 与 y 同量纲: The expanded sum-of-squares form computes MSE from summary totals alone, avoiding a per-sample pass. RMSE is in the same unit as y but is sensitive to outliers, while MAE is more robust. R² is the improvement relative to simply predicting the mean and can be negative, meaning the model is worse than the baseline.
map.填写「真实值之和」。: Enter the sum of the actual values.
map.填写「预测值之和」。: Enter the sum of the predicted values.
map.填写「真实值平方和」。: Enter the sum of squares of the actual values.
map.填写「预测值平方和」。: Enter the sum of squares of the predicted values.
map.填写「真实×预测之和」。: Enter the sum of actual × predicted.
map.MSE=mean((y−ŷ)²)；RMSE=√MSE 与原始量纲一致，便于解释。: MSE = mean((y−ŷ)²); RMSE = √MSE is in the same unit as the original values, which makes it easier to interpret.
map.MAE=mean|y−ŷ| 对离群更稳健；R²=1−SS_res/SS_tot: MAE = mean|y−ŷ| is more robust to outliers; R² = 1−SS_res/SS_tot measures the proportion of variance explained.
map.回归评估应同时看 RMSE/MAE(误差量级)与 R²(拟合优度)。: Regression evaluation should look at RMSE/MAE (error magnitude) and R² ( goodness of fit) together.
map.：真实 [3,5,2], 预测 [2.5,5,3]：残差 [0.5,0,−1]，: Actual [3,5,2], predicted [2.5,5,3]: residuals [0.5,0,−1], MSE=(0.25+0+1)/3=0.417, RMSE=0.646, MAE=(0.5+0+1)/3=0.5, and R² needs the mean to compute the explained variance.
map.RMSE 和 MAE 哪个好？: Which is better, RMSE or MAE?
map.RMSE 对大误差惩罚更重(平方)，对离群敏感；MAE 更稳健、直观。关注极端偏: RMSE punishes large errors more heavily (squared) and is sensitive to outliers; MAE is more robust and intuitive. Watch RMSE for extreme deviations (such as share prices) and MAE for average deviation.
map.R² 为负说明什么？: What does a negative R² mean?
map.说明模型比'直接取均值'还差，拟合失败；可能特征无用、过拟合或数据本身无结构，需: It means the model is worse than simply taking the mean, so the fit has failed; the features may be useless, the model overfitted, or the data itself may have no structure, so the features and the model need reworking.
